MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 354 December 26, 1973
RESERVING FOR RESEARCH AND INSTRUCTION PURPOSES OF MAN AND THE BIOSPHERE
(MAB) OF THE PHILIPPINES A CERTAIN PARCEL OF LAND OF THE PUBLIC DOMAIN SITUATED
IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF PUERTO GALERA, PROVINCE OF ORIENTAL MINDORO
WHEREAS, the Man and the Biosphere (MAB) of the Philippines is conducting specific studies on the effects
of human activities on ecosystems of mountains, grasslands, forests, water bodies and coastal zones;
WHEREAS, the MAB has selected Puerto Galera and the surrounding mountains (Mts. Alinyaban,
Malasimbo and Talipanan) in Oriental Mindoro bounded on the west by Camerong River as its pilot research
project site for satisfying the following requirements: availability of suitable components of ecosystems
affected by varying degrees of human disturbances, existence of governmental and academic research stations,
and accessibility of the area to the MAB Task Forces;
WHEREAS, the MAB pilot research project requires an area without uncontrollable human activities, such as
logging, fishing, unjudicious collection and destruction of corals and other biological resources, and docking;
WHEREAS, the main objectives of the MAB program is to obtain information through inter-disciplinary
research as rational basis for efficient utilization and management of our natural resources; and
WHEREAS, the University of the Philippines has endorsed the MAB projects above contemplated and for this
purpose has requested and proposed the reservation of Puerto Galera Bay and vicinity for research and
instruction purposes;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by law, do hereby set aside as civil reservation for research and instruction purposes of the Man
and Biosphere (MAB) of the Philippines, Puerto Galera and the surrounding mountains of Alinyaban,
Malasimbo and Talipanan, including Puerto Galera Bay and vicinity in the Province of Oriental Mindoro.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, I have hereunto set my hand and caused the seal of the Republic of the Philippines
to be affixed.
Done in the City of Manila, this 26th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
